label: The app
say: This is a simple to-do app. Everything starts in the box at the top.

label: Add tasks
say: Type a task and press Enter. Each one lands in the list below.

label: Finish a task
say: Tick the circle to mark a task as done.

label: Filter the list
say: Use the filters to see only what is left, or only what is finished.

label: Tidy up
say: Back on All, Clear completed removes everything you have finished.
